July 9, 2019 

BY ELECTRONIC FILING AND HAND DELIVERY 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:

Simon E. Rodriguez, as Chapter 7 Trustee for the Bankruptcy Estate 
of United Western Bancorp, Inc. v. Federal Deposit Insurance 
Corporation, as Receiver for United Western Bank, No. 18-1269 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I  am  Counsel  of  Record  for  Petitioner  in  this  case.    Petitioner  respectfully 
requests an 18-day extension of time, to and including August  30, 2019, to file his 
opening  brief  and  joint  appendix.    Counsel  for  Respondent  has  consented  to  this 
extension. 

In  turn,  Petitioner  has  consented  to  an  18-day  extension  of  time  for 
Respondent  to  file  its  brief,  to  and  including  October  17,  2019.    Under  the  Court’s 
rules, Petitioner’s reply brief would be due 30 days later (or at the time specified in 
Rule 25.3). 

Respectfully submitted, 

Neal K. Katyal 
Counsel of Record for Petitioner
